name: items
label: Items
description: A list of notifications to be displayed

type.description: Type of message to be displayed. This determines how the notification is styled (error|info|warning)

contentType.description: Type of content to be passed. Accepts only 'html' or 'string' options. For 'html', the caller is responsible for escaping all data to avoid XSS attacks. For 'string', content is automatically escaped.
